title: Real-issuer Deep Research pack with a bounded research question
purpose: C22: a question-specific pack — an approved research brief, the complete relevant evidence set for that question, the expected synthesis, forbidden conclusions and an independently authored conclusion, plus time-bounded external evidence supplied as documents (never fetched by the application).
provenance: Research analyst: brief, evidence set and conclusion authored and approved outside the repository

bytes.artifact: research-brief.json satisfying the brief contract, the evidence documents the question needs, the expected synthesis and forbidden conclusions in the answer key, all digest-pinned

documents.reason: the governed brief; the host proposes the plan from it and the analyst approves the exact hash
placeholder row: the analyst replaces it with the question's complete evidence set (one row per document)
